title: Milestone
description: A checkable future state with its own done-when clauses (design part 3.2, Milestones and releases). One kind, milestone. A learning milestone is one whose check is a study: done when its question is answered. That is derived from the check, never stored. A milestone with no parent is a long outcome, whose constraints are other milestones. Named by its outcome, never numbered: the check refuses a name such as M1, v2 or phase 3. In the files backend each list entry is one line of text (see the format notes on each field); this schema covers the entity as the read API returns it. Derived fields (error, check_due, scope, tokens_spent, cost_of_delay_rate, to_shape) are never stored.

parent.description: The project it belongs to. Optional: a milestone with no parent is a long outcome, whose constraints are other milestones.

state.description: proposed, planned, done or dropped. A milestone is never in-progress: work items are claimed, milestones are not.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this record. Defaults to the owner: the person who holds the project's decision rights.

opened_from.description: Signal, project or decision IDs this was opened from.

outcome.description: One sentence: the state for users, or the question answered.

package.description: The release package the milestone is released in, one declared in policy.json release.packages. Optional: with one package declared, it is that one; a milestone that names none is in no package's release records when several are declared.

done_when.description: Clauses, each with a short ID. Stored as "c1: <text>".

constraints.description: Constraints: items or milestones without which a clause cannot be true, each linked to that clause. Stored as "<ID> c1", or "<ID> c?" for a constraint still to be linked to a clause at shaping.

clause.description: The clause it is linked to; null while it is still to be linked at shaping.

contributions.description: Contributions: items that add to the outcome. Stored as "<ID> value=<number above 0> confidence=<0 to 1>". Value is in the project's value units, the same as a project's value; 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 and 13 are quick choices, not the only values.

appetite_tokens.description: What the milestone is worth, in tokens.

deadline.description: An external date and its source, never an internal estimate. Stored as "<YYYY-MM-DD> <source>".

check.description: The independent check that the outcome holds. Stored as "<kind> <target>": demo and a script, integration-test and a test path, or study and a study ID.

check_results.description: Each recorded run of the check, oldest first. Stored as "<pass | fail | answered> <YYYY-MM-DD> <role>: <evidence>". Only a pass (for a learning milestone, answered: its study has a verdict) by a role other than the items' authors moves the milestone to done.
